title: VIGIA ML nomination
description: A candidate event the ML triage layer NOMINATES for adjudication by the deterministic core. Nominations are hints, not verdicts: they carry no decision semantics, their scores are advisory floats that never enter a sealed payload, and the core is free to ignore them. If a nominated event matters, the core re-derives its weight with exact arithmetic from the underlying evidence.

window_id.description: The evidence window this nomination points into.

nominated_by.description: Fixed marker so downstream code can never mistake a nomination for a core-derived signal.

detector.description: Which detector fired (e.g. rare-type, rare-transition, timing-burst, timing-beacon, content-surprisal).

surprisal_bits.description: Advisory anomaly score in bits (-log2 p). Float is acceptable HERE ONLY: the nomination layer is outside every sealed path by construction.

rank.description: Position in the shortlist for this window (1 = most surprising).

reason.description: Plain-language explanation of why this event was nominated.
